overview: The Medford School Committee met to review COVID-19 health protocols, receive reports on district assessments, professional development, and quarterly finances, and approve a resolution to draft a student dress code policy.

items.title: Consent Agenda and Student Advisory Update
items.summary: The committee approved the consent agenda and received a brief update regarding student representation on the Medford Student Advisory Council.

items.title: Report of Superintendent
items.summary: Superintendent Marice Edouard-Vincent highlighted recent school activities, academic testing, facility projects, and apologized for bus transportation delays caused by a national driver shortage.

items.title: Public Health Update
items.summary: District staff reported on COVID-19 testing metrics, kindergarten daily testing, employee vaccination rates, and HVAC testing, while addressing public inquiries regarding ventilation and student vaccination rates.

items.title: Common Assessment Tool SY 21-22
items.summary: Administrators presented the NWEA MAP computer-adaptive assessment platform selected to establish baseline learning data across grades K–12.

items.title: Professional Learning and Development Priorities
items.summary: Administrators outlined professional development programs for the school year, focusing on special education IEP goal writing, literacy coaching, Responsive Classroom, and secondary social-emotional learning.

items.title: Fiscal Year 22 Quarterly Budget Update
items.summary: Assistant Superintendent David Murphy provided a first-quarter update on the operating budget and ESSER grant expenditures.

items.title: Resolution on Student Dress Code Policy
items.summary: The committee approved a resolution directing the Rules, Policy and Equity Subcommittee to draft a student dress code policy by February 28, 2022.

items.title: Condolences
items.summary: The committee expressed condolences to the families of Adeline Scarpelli and Mary M. O'Sullivan.
